#!/bin/bash

    su -s /bin/bash "$USER_NAME" -c "sleep 300 &"
done
echo "Started $NUM_PROCESSES processes as user $USER_NAME"
EOF

sleep 1
ps aux | grep "$USER_NAME" | grep -v grep
